rationale: Suspicious: 2 signal(s) needing review; e.g. uses a peripheral api not declared in the manifest.

findings.title: Uses a peripheral API not declared in the manifest
findings.detail: Uses the serial peripheral API but the manifest declares no matching permission. Undeclared peripheral use is suspicious; combined with off-package egress it is treated as dangerous.

findings.title: Uses a peripheral API not declared in the manifest
findings.detail: Uses the bluetooth peripheral API but the manifest declares no matching permission. Undeclared peripheral use is suspicious; combined with off-package egress it is treated as dangerous.

findings.title: Peripheral declared in manifest but never used
findings.detail: The manifest declares a "usb" permission but no code uses that peripheral API. Harmless, but worth confirming the declaration is intended.

limitations: Static heuristic scan. A GOOD verdict means no known-bad pattern matched, NOT proof of safety. Human review is still required for every submission.
